title: PS5 Pulse Elevate speakers delayed indefinitely 🔊
subject: pulseelevate
description:
Were you planning to buy these? 👇

Sony has delayed the PlayStation Pulse Elevate wireless speakers indefinitely, days before their November 12, 2026 launch at $219.99. A PlayStation Blog update says quality testing found a production issue. No new release date has been given.

Sources: PlayStation Blog update via Push Square (Nov 8, 2026), Press Start (Nov 7, 2026), PCQuest (Nov 7, 2026)

scenes.text: Sony has delayed its PS5 speakers indefinitely.
The Pulse Elevate speakers were due on November 12, priced at $219.99.
An update on the PlayStation Blog says quality testing turned up a production issue.
Review units had already reached press and influencers that same week.
Sony's Edwin Foo said the extra time will make sure the speakers deliver the experience Sony intended.
There's no new date. The FlexStrike arcade stick, once due August 6, is still on hold too.
